headline: About 17,300 Pampanga Residents Stay in Evacuation Centers as Flooding Persists
seoTitle: 17,300 in Pampanga Evacuation Centers | FMB News
seoDescription: Pampanga says about 17,300 residents from 4,622 families are in 270 evacuation centers as prolonged flooding continues.
deck: The provincial count covers evacuees in centers and does not include residents who remained in flooded homes.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Pampanga Governor Lilia Pineda said around 17,300 residents, representing 4,622 families, were staying in 270 evacuation centers as prolonged flooding continued across the province.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Pineda said the figure does not include people who remained in their homes. She described flooding in some areas as unusually severe, with backflow and saturated downstream communities contributing to persistent water levels.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Thousands of displaced residents need sustained food, water, sanitation, medical support and safe shelter while floodwaters remain high.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Evacuation numbers can change quickly. Watch provincial and municipal updates on water levels, road access, relief distribution and return-home advisories.
